title: Floor 12
overview: Miles Miller and Hazel Brown have been inseparable since fourth grade, spending their childhood riding bikes, eating ice cream, and playing in the yard together. But after a falling out at seventeen, the two are suddenly forced to reconnect six years later and confront the memory that tore them apart. Having not spoken since, the story unfolds through a series of flashbacks intertwined with their tense present-day encounter inside an elevator.
